comment: Every leaderboard is a single-field orderBy with a limit, and Firestore
indexes every field automatically, so no composite indexes are required.
Nested paths like perMachine.jaxon.bestMulti are covered by the automatic
If a board is ever extended with a filter (e.g. 'top scores this month'),
that combination will need a composite entry here — the Firestore error
message includes a direct link that generates it.
